title: Bảo vệ ngân sách CI bằng timeout-minutes và PR Concurrency
code:
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10

title: Khai báo Service Container Redis 7 kèm Healthcheck chuẩn
code:
services:
  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    options: >-
      --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
      --health-interval 5s
      --health-retries 5
